subject: taking a compliment
caption: Which one do you do? Deflecting a compliment is just telling someone their taste is wrong.

beats.text: Someone compliments you. There are four ways people ruin it.
You immediately explain why it wasn't actually that good.
You say thank you. That's it. Somehow that's the uncomfortable one.
You assume they want something. Nobody's ever just nice.
You make a joke before anyone can take it seriously.
A compliment is a gift. You're allowed to keep it.
Follow for the stuff nobody teaches you.
